caption: Shopify just rolled out a major webhook update for developers using the Ajax and Storefront APIs. Redundant notifications are officially a thing of the past. #ShopifyDev #Webhooks #EcommerceDev #APIs

slides.title: Smarter Cart Webhooks
slides.subtitle: Unchanged carts no longer trigger update webhooks

slides.title: What's New in Carts
cards: Cart operations resulting in zero cart changes no longer fire webhooks.
Resubmitting existing cart values will not trigger duplicate alerts.
This update was officially released on October 12, 2026.

left.label: Previously
left.title: Every Request
items: Every cart operation produced a webhook
Fired regardless of actual cart data changes
Created high volumes of redundant traffic

right.label: Now
right.title: Actual Changes
items: Webhooks only fire on genuine modifications
Contents or properties must actually change

slides.title: Affected Endpoints
cards: Updates apply directly to standard Ajax API cart operations.
Storefront API cart requests now benefit from smarter webhook triggers.
Developers receive precisely one notification per true modification.

slides.title: Why This Matters
events: Apps no longer receive repetitive alerts for identical requests.
Webhook handling code can focus strictly on real state changes.
Reduced event volume optimizes overall application processing.

slides.title: Optimize Your Apps
slides.subtitle: Review your webhook handlers to take advantage of this cleaner event stream.
